rationale: Numbers 24:17 reads, in Balaam's oracle of a coming ruler, "A star will come forth from Jacob, and a scepter will arise from Israel." Matthew's Magi describe following "His star" (40.2.2), with "the star" reappearing to guide them the rest of the way to the Child (40.2.9-10). Moises Mayordomo's assessment, reported via the intertextual.bible aggregator used here, is that the verbal correspondence between the two passages is low -- essentially the single shared word "star" -- and that Matthew never cites Numbers directly or marks the allusion. The label is plausible rather than strong because the connection rests on a single shared term and a thematic resemblance (a star tied to a coming ruler) rather than on matching phrases or a citation formula; Mayordomo's own chapter was not independently read for this lesson.
